title: Laredo Police Share Recap of Notorious Drug House Demolition
excerpt: The Laredo Police Department shared a video recap of the demolition of a notorious drug house, saying the department is committed to a safer Laredo.
content:
The Laredo Police Department has shared a video recap of the demolition of a notorious drug house in Laredo.

The department posted the recap video on Tuesday, November 25, with the message that it is committed to a safer Laredo.

The department did not give an address for the house or a date for the demolition in the post.

Update — November 25, 2026: KGNS reports the home was in the Olive and Sanders area and, according to the Laredo Police Department, was linked to five overdose deaths. Neighbors who lived beside the house for years told KGNS they are relieved it is gone, saying the home had long been a concern because of drug activity there. The home had also been a target for both the police department and Code Enforcement.

Sources: Laredo Police Department, Nov. 25, 2026; KGNS, Nov. 25, 2026.
